name: Gift with purchase
description: The app's pages: gift with purchase settings and upsell deals.

gift.heading: Gift with purchase
gift.howCart: While a promo is on, each gift is added to the cart automatically as soon as the customer reaches its spend amount, as its own line, and taken out again if they drop below it.
gift.howCheckout: Gifts are always free at checkout, and checkout won't let anyone pay for a gift that's no longer earned.
gift.howCodes: No discount codes work while a promo is on, VIP codes included: customers keep them for their next order.
gift.howLook: How the gifts look in the cart (cards, list or bar, and their colors) is in the theme editor: Cart drawer → Gift with purchase.
gift.previewHelp: Customers don't see the promo yet. Open this link to try it on the live site, in this browser only:
gift.datesHelp: Leave both empty to run the promo until you turn it off. Dates use the store's time zone ({{timezone}}): the promo starts at the beginning of the start date and ends at the end of the end date.
gift.tiersHelp: Up to 3. Customers get the gift for every tier they reach, so someone who reaches all 3 gets all 3 gifts. Gifts are added as their own line items, from the gift product's own stock.
gift.vipHelp: For VIP codes from Klaviyo. When a code starting with these letters is in the cart, its gift is added automatically. The code itself makes the gift free, so set it up as 100% off this product only. VIP codes can't be used while a promo is on.
gift.vipPrefixHelp: The code prefix you set in Klaviyo, e.g. VIPWIPE
gift.codesMessage: Message when someone uses a code during a promo
gift.codesMessageHelp: Shown in the cart and at checkout.
gift.codesMessagePlaceholder: Discount codes can't be used during this promotion. Save yours for your next order!
gift.saved: Gift settings saved. The store picks them up within a minute.

errors.tierAmount: Each tier needs a spend amount above $0.
errors.vipPrefix: Each VIP gift needs the code's starting letters.
errors.vipGift: Each VIP gift needs a gift.
errors.vipDuplicate: Two VIP gifts use the same code prefix.
errors.noTiers: Add at least one gift tier before turning the promo on or previewing it.
errors.dates: The end date can't be before the start date.

upsell.heading: Upsell deals
upsell.howDeal: Each product below drops to its deal price in the cart, at any quantity.
upsell.howQualifier: The deal only applies when the cart also has a regular product (one that's not on this list). A cart of only deal products pays full price.
upsell.howExceptions: A deal product on a subscription gets the subscription price instead, never both. Free gifts are never charged.
upsell.howWhere: The cart drawer's "Complete your order" offers and the checkout's "Stay fresh" block show these deal prices. Which products they suggest is set in the theme editor (Cart drawer → Upsell) and the checkout editor.
upsell.discountHelp: This discount runs both the upsell deal and the gift with purchase promos. Turning it off stops both.
upsell.noDiscount: No active discount runs these deals. Create an automatic discount with this app's function (Discounts → Create discount) for the deal prices to apply.
upsell.productsHelp: The deal price is what the customer pays per unit while the deal applies. It must be lower than the product's regular price.
upsell.empty: No products are on the deal yet.
upsell.saved: Upsell deals saved. The store uses the new prices right away.

errors.dealPrice: Each product needs a deal price above $0.
errors.dealNotLower: A deal price must be lower than the product's regular price.
